The corrected /v1/resources/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/ratings matches the registered Resource route after substituting the same fixture UUID.

review.invariant: The regression assertion uses actual header output and the real route registry

Lines 52-58 construct createMainApp with dependencies, take app.routes entries whose method is GET, substitute :resource with the fixture Work's UUID, and assert containment of header.links.ratings. The expectation does not insert a copied canonical URL or fake route owner. Existing query-count, synopsis-query, no-placement and missing-Work assertions remain.
review.assessment: Accepted. Before the production change, the same candidate test blob rejects the advertised Works ratings path. Afterward it accepts the Resource path. The unchanged work-read.test.ts:22-46 independently checks registered canonical route presence and legacy Works ratings route absence.
review.fixturePremises: The header session is explicitly cast from a handcrafted WorkReadSession: unpublished Work basis, fake principal, permitted canReadWork, denied canEditWork, fake graph rows and summaries, and test epoch/sequence. Main is constructed with a non-serving Fuseki URL at 127.0.0.1:1, fake account/access dependencies and synthetic lineage. The added assertion inspects app.routes; it never calls app.handle, listens, fetches the advertised ratings route or validates a public corpus Work.
review.qualification: Route inventory plus fixture output establishes a source contract. It does not establish HTTP routing through Elysia, a deployed GET 200, ratings contents, ordinary public admission, browser success or the original product journey.
